Class AgiContext

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.internal.AgiContext
public final class AgiContext extends Object
Bridge between IntelliJ VirtualFile selections and the per-session Anahata ResourceManager, backing the Project-view "AGI Context" node decorator and popup action.

This is the IntelliJ counterpart of the NetBeans FilesContextActionLogic. It adds and removes files (recursing into directories) from a session's context, and reports membership so the decorator can badge in-context files. All session lookups go through the live IntellijAsiContainer.getInstances() registry.

anahata
